data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 322.192m. During calendar year 2020 the syndicate experienced favourable prior-year development, with back years (2017 and prior) contributing approximately GBP 17.6m to the annual result (a release). The report also records an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of circa GBP 6.0m for 2020 driven by lower-than-expected incurred movements across most classes. Primary drivers cited include favourable claims development on older years, improved performance on certain accounts (notably Irish motor) and select favourable legal/arbitration outcomes. Named exposures for 2020 included Hurricane Laura and COVID-19 provisions; the largest reserve pools remain in reinsurance acceptances and property-related lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary opening gross reserves taken from 2020 balance sheet liabilities (claims outstanding). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided in a single 'movement in prior years' note; the report gives prior-year contribution to calendar result (GBP 17.6m) and an overall net surplus in ultimate claims (GBP 6.0m). The GBP 17.6m figure used here is presented in the managing agent narrative as the back-years contribution (likely NET of reinsurance). A gross PYD figure was not unambiguously stated in GBP; thus the prior year movement value is treated as a net figure and flagged accordingly. A gross claims development triangle is present (in GBP '000) and was not used to compute PYD due to the presence of an aggregate '2010 and prior' column and potential distortions from RITC/reinsurance movements; triangle data are provided in _claims_triangle for cross-checking.
